en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeshore. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the grassy bank of a calm lake, with birch trees, a small boat pulled up on shore, and a stacked pile of branches or logs in the foreground. Across the water, low forested hills with scattered houses are visible. The caption printed at the top right reads "Saugtjernet, Elverum".
